messages:
maria: Heads-up -- during the 03:10 UTC autoscale window we saw a burst of NVLink/PCIe errors coming from pool5 (rack5).

maria: Symptoms: 9/40 GPUs in pool5 reported repeated AER Xid/UECC events and intermittent NVLink link down/up. Tail latency for small-chat jobs spiked ~30% and a couple inference pods retried 5-6 times.

maria: Nodes observed: rack5-node03 (gpu1,gpu2), rack5-node07 (gpu0), rack5-node12 (gpu3). Error counters increasing from ~0 -> 1200 Xid events over 10m on affected cards.

jon: Can you paste dmesg + nvidia-smi? Any recent firmware/driver changes in that cluster?

maria: pastebin: https://internal/paste/zz9k (short dumps) but key snippets inline: 
```
[ 12345.678901] pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Multiple Corrected error detected: receiver ID 0000:66:00.0
[ 12345.679012] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:66:00): 31, PID 3124, GPU 0000:66:00.0
[ 12346.002345] nvlink0: link0: down
[ 12346.102112] nvlink0: link0: up
```

nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,driver_model.current,retired_pages --format=csv,noheader
```
0, 12 %, 45 C, WDDM, 0
1, 9 %, 44 C, WDDM, 0
2, 0 %, 38 C, WDDM, 2
3, 5 %, 41 C, WDDM, 0
```

pat: infra-bot already opened PD-3282 and attached a node-level snapshot. fleet-bot: mark affected nodes as p5-critical?

fleet-bot: PD incident created: PD-3282. Affected resource tags: pool=pool5, rack=rack5. Auto-snapshot collected.

jon: Looks like link flaps coincide with AER corrected errors -> could be flaky riser/card or PCIe fabric noisiness. Let's do a controlled drain of the three nodes and move workloads to pool6/dedicated burst for tonight. We should avoid mass eviction while autoscaler is spinning.

leah: Quick note on capacity: pool5 is at 85% reserved commit. Draining 3 nodes (~12 GPUs) will push preemptible queue and increase latency for queued training jobs. Recommend temporary reserved burst to Dedicated if we expect >1h repair.

maria: Action plan proposal:
- Immediately cordon + drain rack5-node03, node07, node12 (start now)
- Run PCIe retrain test + nvlink stress on drained nodes (30m)
- If Xid counters > 500 during test or repeated nvlink down/up -> schedule hot-swap/RMA for GPU(s)
- If tests stable, bring back with conservative BIOS PCIe speed fallback (Gen3) for 24h and monitor

pat: Commands I ran for drain: 
```
infractl node cordon rack5-node03 --reason "nvlink flaps"
infractl node drain rack5-node03 --grace-period 300
```

pat: Also ran quick BMC check, SEL showed repeated PCIe AER messages, no thermal alerts.

jon: Can we try firmware microcode bump v2.3 on a single node (node07) after drain? Vendor notes mention a fix for link training anomalies. We should mirror to one node only, not the whole pool.

leah: I'll open a short cost approval with product for temporary Dedicated burst (estimate +$1.2k for the evening). Approving ASAP if repairs take >2h.

maria: Ran the nvlink stress harness on node03 for 25m, results: intermittent link down/up every ~6-8s, Xid delta ~+640. node07 showed similar but lower frequency.

maria: Given numbers, recommending RMA for the GPUs in node03 (gpu1/gpu2) and node12 gpu3. node07 gpu0 flagged for firmware trial first.

infra-oncall: tagging @oncall to coordinate physical swap window. Can lab schedule tech for rack5 slot swaps tomorrow 09:00 local?

jon: Also we should add a short-term autoscale policy tweak: prefer pool6 for new small-chat pods in eu-west-2 to reduce tail-latency impact while we remediate. Pat, can you add a rule?

pat: Will add route rule and throttle burst to pool6. Also setting a per-node NVLink Xid alert threshold (>=500 in 10m) to escalate earlier.

leah: Vendor ticket opened (VEND-9147) referencing PD-3282. Vendor recommended: PCIe retrain, microcode v2.3, and if persistent, RMA under advanced replacement.

maria: Summary / next steps:
1) node03,node07,node12 drained (in progress)
2) run microcode on node07 post-drain (jon)
3) stress + retrain test results to PD-3282 and attach telemetry (maria)
4) schedule swap for node03/node12 GPUs tomorrow 09:00 if RMA approved (infra-oncall)
5) temporary routing to pool6 + Dedicated burst approval (leah)

pat: thumbs up. adding checklist to PD-3282. :white_check_mark:

jon: If anything changes ping me. Good job catching this early, Maria. :hammer_and_wrench:

maria: Thanks — will keep updates in this thread as we progress.
